title: Container images
description: For a project that builds container images: pinned base images, non-root users, multi-stage builds, build secrets and the build context.

rules.instruction: Pin each `FROM` image to a version tag and a digest, and update the digest through a reviewed change.
rules.verification: Search the Dockerfiles for `FROM` lines without `@sha256:` or with `latest`.

rules.instruction: Create a dedicated user with an explicit UID and switch to it with `USER` before the entrypoint when the service needs no privileges.
rules.verification: Run the built image and check that `id -u` inside the container is not 0.

rules.instruction: Use a multi-stage build so compilers, package managers and test files stay out of the final stage.
rules.verification: List the packages or files of the final image and confirm build tools are absent.

rules.instruction: Pass credentials needed at build time through secret or SSH mounts, never through `ARG`, `ENV` or copied files.
rules.verification: Inspect the image history and configuration (`docker history`, `docker inspect`) for secret values or credential file names.

rules.instruction: Exclude `.git`, local environment files, credentials and build output from the build context with `.dockerignore`.
rules.verification: Review `.dockerignore` and check that the context does not include `.env` files or keys.

rules.instruction: Do not build from an image tagged `latest`: pin each `FROM` image to a version tag and a digest.
rules.verification: task verify evaluates the check on the working tree; review each file it names.
